chunks.en: Would you rather meet in the morning or the afternoon?
chunks.zh: 您比較想早上開，還是下午開？
accept: Would you rather meet in the morning or in the afternoon?
Would you rather meet in the morning or afternoon?
chunks.note: 請對方二選一。Would you rather…? 是客氣地問「比較想要哪一個」。

distractors.text: Would you rather to meet in the morning or the afternoon?
Would rather you meet in the morning or the afternoon?
Would you rather meet on the morning or the afternoon?

chunks.en: Does Thursday at ten work for you?
chunks.zh: 星期四早上十點您方便嗎？
accept: Does Thursday at 10 work for you?
chunks.note: 提一個時間，問對方方不方便。work for you＝對你來說可以。

distractors.text: Do Thursday at ten work for you?
Does Thursday at ten works for you?
Does Thursday at ten work you?

chunks.en: How do I book the conference room?
chunks.note: 問預約的方法。book 當動詞是「預訂」。

distractors.text: How I book the conference room?
How do I book conference room?
How do I books the conference room?

chunks.en: Is the room free between ten and eleven?
chunks.zh: 那間十點到十一點有空嗎？
accept: Is the room free between 10 and 11?
chunks.note: 問某段時間有沒有空。between A and B＝在 A 和 B 之間。

distractors.text: Is the room free between ten or eleven?
Is room free between ten and eleven?
Is the room free between ten to eleven?

chunks.en: Should I add anything else to the agenda?
chunks.note: 問對方還要不要補充。anything else＝其他任何事情。

distractors.text: Should I add anything other to the agenda?
Should I add anything else the agenda?
Should I adding anything else to the agenda?

chunks.en: If we start on time, we'll finish by eleven.
chunks.zh: 準時開始的話，十一點前就能結束。
accept: If we start on time, we will finish by eleven.
If we start on time, we'll finish by 11.
chunks.note: 第一條件句：If＋現在式，後半句用 will；if 後面不用 will。

distractors.text: If we will start on time, we'll finish by eleven.
If we started on time, we'll finish by eleven.
If we start on the time, we'll finish by eleven.

chunks.en: Would you mind sending me your slides today?
chunks.zh: 可以麻煩你今天把投影片傳給我嗎？
chunks.note: 客氣地請人幫忙。Would you mind 後面接 -ing。

distractors.text: Would you mind send me your slides today?
Would you mind to send me your slides today?
Would you mind sending your slides me today?

chunks.en: Here's a quick update on the new filing system.
chunks.zh: 我簡單報告一下新歸檔系統的進度。
accept: Here is a quick update on the new filing system.
chunks.note: 開始報告進度。update on＋事情＝那件事的最新進度。

distractors.text: Here's quick update on the new filing system.
Here's a quickly update on the new filing system.
Here's a quick update at the new filing system.

chunks.en: So far, everything is on schedule.
chunks.zh: 到目前為止都照進度在走。
accept: So far everything is on schedule.
chunks.note: 報告到目前的狀況。on schedule＝照進度；everything 動詞用 is。

distractors.text: So far, everything are on schedule.
So far, everything is in schedule.
So far, everything on schedule.

chunks.en: I'm not against the idea, but it's a big change.
chunks.zh: 我不是反對這個想法，只是變動滿大的。
accept: I am not against the idea, but it's a big change.
chunks.note: 委婉表達保留：先說不反對，再用 but 說出顧慮。

distractors.text: I'm not against idea, but it's a big change.
I'm not against the idea, but it's a big changes.
I not against the idea, but it's a big change.

chunks.en: I prefer the one that's easier to use.
chunks.zh: 我比較喜歡好上手的那一個。
accept: I prefer the one that is easier to use.
I prefer the one which is easier to use.
chunks.note: 關係子句 that：that's easier to use 說明是哪一個 the one，指東西用 that。

distractors.text: I prefer the one who's easier to use.
I prefer the one that's more easier to use.
I prefer the one that easier to use.

chunks.en: Could you go over the second point again?
chunks.zh: 第二點可以請您再說一次嗎？
chunks.note: 沒聽清楚時請對方再講一次。go over＝重新講一遍。

distractors.text: Could you go over the two point again?
Could you go over second point again?
Could you go over the second points again?

chunks.en: Which of these should I work on first?
chunks.zh: 這幾件事我應該先做哪一件？
chunks.note: 事情很多時請主管排先後。which of these＝這些當中的哪一個。

distractors.text: Which of these I should work on first?
Which of this should I work on first?
Which of these should I work first?

chunks.note: 聽完對方的理由，表示同意。make sense＝有道理。

distractors.text: That make sense to me.
That makes a sense to me.
That makes sense me.

words.zh: 項目（agenda item 議程項目）
以……為根據（based on 根據）
效果（take effect 開始實施）
筆記；記錄（take notes 做記錄）
行動（action item 待辦事項）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll be away on business next Monday, so I need your help.
scene.zh: 我下星期一要出差，所以需要你幫忙。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But let's not cancel our weekly meeting. Can you reschedule it?
scene.zh: 不過週會不要取消。你可以幫忙改個時間嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would you rather meet in the morning or the afternoon?
scene.zh: 您比較想早上開，還是下午開？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Either is fine. I'm free any day between Tuesday and Thursday.
scene.zh: 都可以。星期二到星期四我哪天都有空。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does Thursday at ten work for you?
scene.zh: 星期四早上十點您方便嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great, that works. Please let the team know today.
scene.zh: 很好，可以。今天麻煩你跟大家說一聲。

fills.en: We have six ___, so we need six chairs.
fills.zh: 我們有六個與會者，所以需要六張椅子。
fills.note: 要坐椅子的是人：attendee 是出席的人。

fills.en: Yesterday, I ___ the conference room for the team.
fills.zh: 我昨天幫大家訂了會議室。
fills.note: 有 yesterday，是過去的事，用過去式 booked。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So you're planning Thursday's meeting, right?
scene.zh: 所以星期四的會是你在安排，對吧？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How do I book the conference room?
scene.zh: 會議室要怎麼訂？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Come with me. It's up on the second floor.
scene.zh: 跟我來，在二樓。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: See the calendar on the side of the door? We share this room with other companies.
scene.zh: 看到門邊那本行事曆了嗎？這間是跟其他公司共用的。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is the room free between ten and eleven?
scene.zh: 那間十點到十一點有空嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me look. Yes, Thursday morning is free. Just write our group's name in.
scene.zh: 我看一下。有，星期四早上沒人訂。把我們組的名字寫上去就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And it has a projector, so bring your laptop.
scene.zh: 這間還有投影機，記得帶筆電。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, let's plan Thursday's agenda together.
scene.zh: 好，我們一起來排星期四的議程。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: First, Dan will present the January sales report.
scene.zh: 首先，Dan 報告一月的業績。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then you'll give a short update on the filing system.
scene.zh: 接著你簡單報告一下歸檔系統的進度。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I add anything else to the agenda?
scene.zh: 議程還需要加什麼嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. Add Dan's proposal as item three, and the June fair last.
scene.zh: 要。把 Dan 的提案放第三項，六月的展覽放最後。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But that's four items in one hour.
scene.zh: 不過一個小時要討論四項。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: If we start on time, we'll finish by eleven.
scene.zh: 準時開始的話，十一點前就能結束。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good point. I'll lead it, and we'll start right at ten.
scene.zh: 有道理。我來主持，十點整準時開始。

passages.title: Team meeting moved to Thursday
lines: I'm away on business on Monday, so this week's meeting is rescheduled to Thursday, 10:00-11:00, in the conference room on the second floor. Please attend.
1. January sales report (Dan will present the results and the main figures)
2. Update on the new filing system
3. A new program for our reports (Dan's proposal)
4. The June fair (This topic involves the entire team.)
Please read the attached report before the meeting. If you have a suggestion for another topic, email me by Wednesday noon.
The projector is ready for Dan's slides. Coffee and refreshments are provided.

questions.en: Why is the meeting on Thursday this week?
questions.zh: 這週的會議為什麼改到星期四？
options: Ms. Carter is away on Monday.
The room is busy on Monday.

questions.en: What should everyone do before the meeting?
questions.zh: 開會前大家要先做什麼？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, did you see Ms. Carter's email about Thursday?
scene.zh: 嘿，你有看到 Ms. Carter 寄的星期四開會的信嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm first on the agenda, with the sales results.
scene.zh: 議程第一項就是我，要報告業績。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: My slides are done. The figures look pretty good.
scene.zh: 投影片做好了，數字看起來還不錯。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would you mind sending me your slides today?
scene.zh: 可以麻煩你今天把投影片傳給我嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not at all. I'll email them after lunch.
scene.zh: 當然不會。吃完午餐我就寄給你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then you can test them on the projector before Thursday.
scene.zh: 這樣你星期四之前就可以先用投影機試試看。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me know if anything looks wrong.
scene.zh: 有什麼不對的地方再跟我說。

lines.en: We're building the new filing system step by step.
lines.zh: 新的歸檔系統我們是一步一步建起來的。

lines.en: Currently, about half of the files are in it.
lines.zh: 目前大約一半的檔案已經放進去了。

lines.en: By year. Only last year's orders are left.
lines.zh: 照年份。只剩去年的訂單還沒弄。

lines.en: By the end of the month.
Based on your progress so far, that sounds right.
lines.zh: 照你到目前的進度來看，應該沒問題。

questions.en: When will the work be finished?
options: By the end of the week
By the end of the month

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, next item. Can you give us your update? Keep it brief.
scene.zh: 好，下一項。可以請你報告一下進度嗎？簡短就好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Here's a quick update on the new filing system.
scene.zh: 我簡單報告一下新歸檔系統的進度。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great, go ahead. How's it going so far?
scene.zh: 好，請說。目前做得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So far, everything is on schedule.
scene.zh: 到目前為止都照進度在走。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good to hear. In fact, I think you're a little ahead of schedule.
scene.zh: 很好。其實我覺得你還有點超前。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Overall, I'm very happy with your progress.
scene.zh: 整體來說，我對你的進度很滿意。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. Now let's move on to Dan's proposal.
scene.zh: 謝謝。接下來是 Dan 的提案。

textFills.title: The new program
lines: Thanks for listening to my proposal on Thursday. I know some of you ___ with it, and that's okay.
The program ___ I showed you is free for one month.
___ Then we can decide together at the next meeting.
zh: 謝謝大家星期四聽我的提案。我知道有些人不同意，這沒關係。
我給大家看的那個程式可以免費用一個月。
請在這星期試用看看，再告訴我你的看法。下次開會我們再一起決定。

blanks.note: disagree with＝不同意，後面才接得上 with。
說明是哪一個程式，指東西用 that。

options: Please try it this week and tell me your view.
The January sales figures look good.
Ms. Carter is away on business next Monday.
I've already bought it for the whole team.
blanks.note: 先請大家試用、說看法，才接得上「再一起決定」。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here's my proposal. Let's switch our reports to a new program.
scene.zh: 我的提案是這樣：報告改用新的程式來做。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No more paper. What's your view?
scene.zh: 不再印紙本。你覺得呢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm not against the idea, but it's a big change.
scene.zh: 我不是反對這個想法，只是變動滿大的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That makes sense. One program has lots of tools, and the other is really simple.
scene.zh: 有道理。有一個程式功能很多，另一個很簡單。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I prefer the one that's easier to use.
scene.zh: 我比較喜歡好上手的那一個。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Absolutely. Let's consider that one first.
scene.zh: 完全同意。那我們先考慮那一個。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now I just need to convince Ms. Carter.
scene.zh: 現在只要說服 Ms. Carter 就好了。

lines.en: Before we conclude, here are today's decisions.
lines.zh: 結束之前，我說一下今天的決議。

lines.en: First, January sales were better than December.
lines.zh: 第一，一月的業績比十二月好。

lines.en: Second, the majority liked Dan's proposal. We'll try the new program for one month.
lines.zh: 第二，大多數人贊成 Dan 的提案。新程式我們先試用一個月。

lines.en: It takes effect on March first, and I intend to decide in April.
lines.zh: 三月一日開始實施，我打算四月再做決定。

lines.en: Third, we don't have all the prices for the upcoming fair yet.
lines.zh: 第三，快到的展覽價錢還沒到齊。

lines.en: So we'll postpone that topic to next week.
lines.zh: 所以這個議題延到下週。

lines.en: Now, the action items. I'd like Dan to show everyone the new program.
lines.zh: 最後是待辦事項。我請 Dan 教大家用新程式。

lines.en: And please send your notes to the whole team today.
lines.zh: 還有，請你今天把會議記錄寄給全組。

questions.en: When will the new program start?
questions.zh: 新程式什麼時候開始用？

questions.en: Which topic will wait until next week?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So those are the decisions. Any questions?
scene.zh: 以上就是今天的決議。有問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you go over the second point again?
scene.zh: 第二點可以請您再說一次嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure. The majority liked Dan's proposal.
scene.zh: 好。大多數人贊成 Dan 的提案。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We'll try his program for a month. It takes effect on March first.
scene.zh: 他的程式我們先試用一個月，三月一日開始。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then I'll make the final decision in April.
scene.zh: 然後我四月再做最後決定。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can you start next week's agenda? Put the fair first.
scene.zh: 你可以先排下週的議程嗎？展覽放第一項。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I add anything else to the agenda?
scene.zh: 議程還需要加什麼嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not yet. Just send your notes to everyone today.
scene.zh: 先不用。今天把會議記錄寄給大家就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Do you have a minute? I have some feedback for you.
scene.zh: 你有空嗎？我想給你一點回饋。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your update was short and effective. Nice work.
scene.zh: 你的報告簡短又有效果，做得很好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You spoke with real confidence, too. That's a big improvement.
scene.zh: 而且你講得很有信心，進步很多。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Now, you have two action items: the notes and next week's agenda.
scene.zh: 你現在有兩件待辦事項：會議記錄和下週的議程。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Which of these should I work on first?
scene.zh: 這幾件事我應該先做哪一件？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The notes, or minutes. People forget things fast after a meeting.
scene.zh: 會議記錄，也就是 minutes。開完會大家很快就忘了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: That makes sense to me.
scene.zh: 我覺得很合理。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. I assume you can send them out today, then.
scene.zh: 很好。那我想你今天應該就能寄出去吧。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm seeing a client next Monday, so let's move our weekly meeting.
scene.zh: 我下星期一要跟客戶見面，週會改個時間吧。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would you rather meet in the morning or the afternoon?
scene.zh: 您比較想早上開，還是下午開？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The morning, please. Either Tuesday or Thursday is fine.
scene.zh: 早上好了。星期二或星期四都可以。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Does Thursday at ten work for you?
scene.zh: 星期四早上十點您方便嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thursday's good for me too. But the room is often busy.
scene.zh: 星期四我也可以。不過會議室常常有人用。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Is the room free between ten and eleven?
scene.zh: 那間十點到十一點有空嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me check the calendar. Yes, it is.
scene.zh: 我查一下行事曆。有，沒人訂。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Now the agenda: Dan's sales results come first.
scene.zh: 太好了。再來是議程：第一項是 Dan 報告業績。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I add anything else to the agenda?
scene.zh: 議程還需要加什麼嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, the filing system. How's it going, by the way?
scene.zh: 要，加上歸檔系統。對了，那個進行得怎麼樣？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So far, everything is on schedule.
scene.zh: 到目前為止都照進度在走。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And my slides for the sales results are ready.
scene.zh: 還有，業績的投影片我做好了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would you mind sending me your slides today?
scene.zh: 可以麻煩你今天把投影片傳給我嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not at all. I'll email them after lunch.
scene.zh: 當然不會。吃完午餐就寄給你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We're choosing between two new programs. Neither is cheap. Which do you like?
scene.zh: 我們在兩個新程式之間挑一個，兩個都不便宜。你喜歡哪一個？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I prefer the one that's easier to use.
scene.zh: 我比較喜歡好上手的那一個。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Me too. So, three things for you: the room, the agenda and the notes.
scene.zh: 我也是。那你有三件事：會議室、議程和會議記錄。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could you go over the second point again?
scene.zh: 第二點可以請您再說一次嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The agenda. Send it out by Wednesday, so everyone can get ready.
scene.zh: 議程。星期三前寄出去，大家才能先準備。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: That makes sense to me.
scene.zh: 我覺得很合理。
